fabricated_details: Leak not yet repaired; operators monitoring
Schedule leak repair during next maintenance window; check coolant level
Inspect HVAC unit before next shift; determine source of rattling
Replace or recalibrate sensor; verify conveyor speed stability
All actions taken are logged in the maintenance system
rationale: The report captures all four issues correctly, but invents an extensive list of unverified actions, follow-ups, timestamps, and maintenance logs. Severities are reasonable, but accuracy is severely compromised by the high volume of fabricated operational details not stated in the input. Readability is strong, but uncertainty handling is limited as it presents several invented follow-up tasks without noting they were absent from the supervisor notes.
